name: Story Share
description: Share movies, shows and music from your library as an Instagram Story card.
overview: Renders a 1080x1920 story card from any library item in nine styles, as a still image or a looping video, and hands it to your phone.

versions.changelog: Ticket and Cassette cut their image plate to the cover's own shape, so the artwork is three to five times larger; Float and Pulse run at half speed on a four second loop.

Covers are set whole inside the ticket band, cassette label and polaroid print instead of being cropped to a middle strip, and the cassette shell is no longer lopsided. Animated cards can now be given a movement: Auto, Float or Pulse, chosen per card once the format is set to video.
The card footer is no longer hardcoded to one server's name: footer text now expands {server} to this Jellyfin server's own name, and the old default is migrated automatically.
Three new card styles (Ticket, Cassette, Review), the item's tagline offered as an optional caption, an in-memory render cache, and the detail-page button is now icon only.

The Story button no longer needs write access to jellyfin-web. The script tag is injected into index.html as it is served rather than written to disk, so it works on distro package installs where /usr/share/jellyfin/web belongs to root, and a server update can no longer remove it. Any tag written by an earlier version is cleaned up on first start.
Fixes the plugin settings page, which failed to save with a JSON error and showed the default style as blank.
First public release: six card styles, background presets, still and animated output.
